notes: OneRel is exported as a single ONNX model.
Inputs are token_ids and mask; outputs are tag_logits and tag_predictions.
Final triple decoding still belongs in the inference service.
Tokenization must preserve OneRel's HBTokenizer behavior, especially appending [unused1] after each whitespace-separated word.
The original hb tokenizer reference is copied as hb_tokenizer.py for deployment-side reuse.
